interface.signature: def leastInterval(self, N: int, K: int, tasks: List[str]) -> int

preconditions.description: The number of tasks N must be between 1 and 10,000.
The cooldown period K must be between 0 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(task in 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ' for task in tasks)
preconditions.description: All tasks must be uppercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The returned time must be at least the number of tasks.
The returned time must equal the maximum of N and the calculated time based on the most frequent task.
